---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a capability, improvement, or research task
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Summary

A clear, one-sentence description of the proposal.

## Problem

What is missing or difficult today, and who is affected.

## Proposed solution

The behavior or capability you would like to see.

## Scope

What this proposal includes. State explicitly what it does not include.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches and why they were rejected.

## Additional context

References, sketches, or related issues. If this proposal requires an architecture decision, note that an ADR will be needed.
